title: SQL Basics Practice Pack
description: Built-in commerce and support dataset for a 24-problem learning path covering SELECT, filtering, JOIN, aggregation, and business-question practice without connecting to a production database.

tables.name: customers
tables.description: Customer accounts used for join and filtering practice.

tables.name: orders
tables.description: Order facts for filtering, joining, and aggregation practice.

tables.name: support_tickets
tables.description: Support requests for status and priority filtering practice.

columns.name: opened_date
columns.description: Ticket open date in ISO format

examples.title: Show paid orders
examples.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' ORDER BY id

examples.title: Join customers and orders
examples.sql: SELECT customers.name, orders.total_amount FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id ORDER BY orders.id

problems.title: List all customers
problems.prompt: Return each customer id, name, and region ordered by id.
problems.hint: Start from the customers table and select only the requested columns.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, name, region FROM customers ORDER BY id

problems.title: Show customer names and segments
problems.prompt: Return customer name and segment for every customer ordered by id.
problems.hint: Use customers and return only name and segment.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT name, segment FROM customers ORDER BY id

problems.title: List orders by date
problems.prompt: Return order id, order_date, and status from earliest to latest order date.
problems.hint: Sort order_date ascending.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, order_date, status FROM orders ORDER BY order_date

problems.title: Review ticket priorities
problems.prompt: Return ticket id, priority, and status ordered by ticket id.
problems.hint: The support_tickets table contains all requested columns.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, priority, status FROM support_tickets ORDER BY id

problems.title: Find the three largest orders
problems.prompt: Return order id and total_amount for the three largest orders, highest amount first.
problems.hint: Sort total_amount descending, then limit the result to three rows.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3

problems.title: Find high-value paid orders
problems.prompt: Return order id, customer_id, and total_amount for paid orders with total_amount at least 100000, ordered by total_amount descending.
problems.hint: Filter status and total_amount together.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND total_amount >= 100000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC

problems.title: Find open high priority tickets
problems.prompt: Return ticket id and customer_id for open high priority tickets ordered by ticket id.
problems.hint: Use support_tickets and filter both priority and status.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, customer_id FROM support_tickets WHERE status = 'open' AND priority = 'high' ORDER BY id

problems.title: Find Seoul customers
problems.prompt: Return customer id, name, and segment for customers in Seoul ordered by id.
problems.hint: Filter customers by the region column.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, name, segment FROM customers WHERE region = 'Seoul' ORDER BY id

problems.title: Find March orders
problems.prompt: Return order id, order_date, and total_amount for orders placed in March 2026 ordered by date.
problems.hint: Use an inclusive lower date bound and an exclusive April upper bound.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01' ORDER BY order_date

problems.title: Find active orders
problems.prompt: Return order id and status for paid or pending orders ordered by id.
problems.hint: Combine the two allowed statuses with OR.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' OR status = 'pending' ORDER BY id

problems.title: Find Seoul and Busan customers
problems.prompt: Return customer id, name, and region for customers in Seoul or Busan ordered by id.
problems.hint: Use IN with the two region values.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, name, region FROM customers WHERE region IN ('Seoul', 'Busan') ORDER BY id

problems.title: Search customer names
problems.prompt: Return customer id and name for customer names containing the letter sequence 'in', ordered by id.
problems.hint: Use LIKE with wildcard characters before and after the text.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT id, name FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%in%' ORDER BY id

problems.title: Join paid orders to customers
problems.prompt: Return customer name, order id, and total_amount for paid orders ordered by order id.
problems.hint: Join customers.id to orders.customer_id.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, orders.id, orders.total_amount FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id WHERE orders.status = 'paid' ORDER BY orders.id

problems.title: Attach customer regions to orders
problems.prompt: Return order id, customer name, and customer region for every order ordered by order id.
problems.hint: Connect orders.customer_id to customers.id.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT orders.id, customers.name, customers.region FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id ORDER BY orders.id

problems.title: Attach customer names to tickets
problems.prompt: Return ticket id, customer name, priority, and status for every support ticket ordered by ticket id.
problems.hint: Join support_tickets.customer_id to customers.id.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT support_tickets.id, customers.name, support_tickets.priority, support_tickets.status FROM support_tickets JOIN customers ON support_tickets.customer_id = customers.id ORDER BY support_tickets.id

problems.title: See segments behind paid orders
problems.prompt: Return order id, customer name, customer segment, and total_amount for paid orders ordered by order id.
problems.hint: Join orders to customers, then filter orders.status.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT orders.id, customers.name, customers.segment, orders.total_amount FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id WHERE orders.status = 'paid' ORDER BY orders.id

problems.title: Locate customers with open tickets
problems.prompt: Return ticket id, customer name, and customer region for open tickets ordered by ticket id.
problems.hint: Join tickets to customers and filter support_tickets.status.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT support_tickets.id, customers.name, customers.region FROM support_tickets JOIN customers ON support_tickets.customer_id = customers.id WHERE support_tickets.status = 'open' ORDER BY support_tickets.id

problems.title: Summarize paid orders by region
problems.prompt: Return region, paid order count, and paid total amount by region ordered by region.
problems.hint: Join customers to orders, filter paid orders, then group by region.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT customers.region, COUNT(orders.id) AS order_count, SUM(orders.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id WHERE orders.status = 'paid' GROUP BY customers.region ORDER BY customers.region

problems.title: Count orders by status
problems.prompt: Return order status and the number of orders in each status ordered by status.
problems.hint: Group orders by status and count order ids.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

problems.title: Calculate paid total by customer
problems.prompt: Return customer name and total paid order amount for customers with paid orders, highest paid total first.
problems.hint: Join customers and orders, keep paid orders, group by customer, then sum total_amount.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, SUM(orders.total_amount) AS paid_total FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id WHERE orders.status = 'paid' GROUP BY customers.id, customers.name ORDER BY paid_total DESC

problems.title: Count tickets by priority
problems.prompt: Return ticket priority and the number of tickets for each priority ordered by priority.
problems.hint: Group support_tickets by priority and count ids.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(id) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority

problems.title: Build a monthly paid-sales summary
problems.prompt: For each month with paid orders, return month (YYYY-MM), paid order count, and paid total amount ordered by month.
problems.hint: Use substr(order_date, 1, 7) to derive the month, filter paid orders, and aggregate by month.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(id) AS order_count, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY substr(order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY month

problems.title: Identify high-value paid customers
problems.prompt: Return customer name and paid_total for customers whose paid order total is at least 200000, highest paid_total first.
problems.hint: Aggregate paid orders by customer and use HAVING on the SUM of total_amount.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, SUM(orders.total_amount) AS paid_total FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id WHERE orders.status = 'paid' GROUP BY customers.id, customers.name HAVING SUM(orders.total_amount) >= 200000 ORDER BY paid_total DESC

problems.title: Measure open support load by region
problems.prompt: Return customer region and open_ticket_count for regions with open support tickets, highest count first and region ascending for ties.
problems.hint: Join tickets to customers, filter open tickets, group by region, and count ticket ids.
problems.expected_sql: SELECT customers.region, COUNT(support_tickets.id) AS open_ticket_count FROM support_tickets JOIN customers ON support_tickets.customer_id = customers.id WHERE support_tickets.status = 'open' GROUP BY customers.region ORDER BY open_ticket_count DESC, customers.region
